hook: Why do so many real millionaires drive old, boring cars while people with far less money drive brand new SUVs? In this video I go through 15 money rules from real millionaires, from three angles: the car math most people ignore, the psychology of not needing a car to feel successful, and the playbook they apply to everything they buy.
